readingMode: All 48 physical pages read completely and sequentially, including every section, table, graph, divider, index and final campaign page. Original pages 1, 2, 11, 19 and 48 visually inspected. No appendix in this recovered variant.
territorialScope: Explicit 23J 2023 Congress/Senate cover and repeated General Election 23J 2023 headers; national Recortes Cero programme for its reconciled Congress ballots. September 2023 preserved original, not a contemporary campaign archive. The separate indexed 53-page main version remains unacquired and is not assumed equivalent.

coverage.authoredAnalysis: Read the entire cover and inspected the original. Recortes Cero identifies the 23-J Congress and Senate campaign. Cover typography is partly absent from native extraction.

Read the entire index and visually inspected its two-column order. Seven main sections run from diagnosis through social, environmental, institutional and foreign-policy proposals. No appendix is listed in this 48-page version.
Read the inflation/banking section divider. No policy text or footnote.
Read the complete opening inflation diagnosis. Claims about causes, banks and purchasing-power loss are partisan analysis, not independently established public help.
Read the continuation of inflation, wage and profit diagnosis in full. Economic percentages and causal assertions remain attributed rather than promised policy effects.
Read all banking, interest-rate and mortgage discussion. This diagnosis does not alone specify the later mortgage-support mechanism.
Read the complete business-profit and household-cost account. Distinguish polemical characterisations from an explicit programme measure.
Read every continuation paragraph of the economic diagnosis. No numeric policy position is assigned from assertions about monopolies or international institutions.
Read the complete concluding diagnosis before the next divider. Claims about enrichment and impoverishment remain attributed to this source.
Read the national-wealth section divider. No independent policy detail.

Read the complete wealth/financial graphic and inspected the original, including figures 245395, 191807 and 590145 million. Repeated graphical header explicitly identifies General Election 23J 2023. No independent financial certification.
Read the full retrospective discussion of wages, furlough protection and social budgets. Historical claimed achievements do not replace present proposal wording.
Read the banking-profit graph and all foreign-ownership discussion. The amounts and causal explanation are source assertions.
Read support for previous minimum-wage/pandemic measures together with its criticism and proposed redistribution alternative. Do not score universal approval of every government measure.
Read the wealth-redistribution section divider. No footnote or appendix.
Read the full explanation of redistribution and control of economic resources. Broad political priorities do not establish every individual tax or ownership proposal.
Read the debt and distribution argument completely. Debt-interest moratorium conditions are specified later; no unconditional all-debt cancellation follows from this introduction.
Read the full financing overview. It states a 1000-euro minimum for salaries and pensions, inconsistent with the later 1200-euro wage and 1080-euro pension detail. Do not silently repair the source.

Read and visually inspected every table row, header and sources footer. The printed pension row says required resources 259000 and mobilised 53700 with balance +38000; totals say required 196100, mobilised 259000, balance +61800. This is not arithmetically coherent and differs from page 29's pension cost 15700. Preserve all figures as printed.
Read the taxation section divider. No substantive measure omitted.
Read the complete fiscal diagnosis and claimed inequalities before the proposed rates. Attribution and taxpayer scope remain necessary.

Read all tax proposals and forecasts: corporate rate 50% for banks, monopolies and multinationals; income-tax upper rate 75% for annual incomes above 600000 euros; extra-profit levy. Do not apply either rate to every taxpayer or every euro of all income.

Read every salary-redistribution paragraph: full-time low wages, a 1200-euro minimum and 10000-euro maximum, with cost/savings forecasts attributed. Implementation starts with public administration on the following page.

Read every phased implementation bullet: public-sector maximum 7000 euros, contractors maximum 10000, minimum 1200, and negotiated progressive extension to small firms/self-employed. Do not describe an immediate identical cap in every business.
Read bank-rescue repayment and European-fund audit/priorities. National industrial and small-business investment emphasis does not establish a universal ban on foreign firms.
Read the entire renegotiated debt-interest moratorium: until growth exceeds 3% and unemployment falls below 7%, plus an audit of illegitimate debt. No automatic cancellation of all principal.

Read all mortgage-levy, anti-corruption and spending bullets. Tasa Cero is a new bank levy funding help equivalent to Euribor-driven increases, not a contractual zero interest rate. Savings explicitly protect public employees' wages, social spending and productive investment.
Read the redistribution-spending section divider. No additional annex.

Read every pension paragraph and bullet: constitutional protection against privatisation/purchasing-power loss, minimum 1080 euros equivalent to minimum wage, cost 15700 million, signatures and municipal/regional motions. No payment count is specified; conflicts with pages 18/40 remain open.

Read all industrial-bank, investment, employment and public-share proposals. Public industrial bank finances small businesses/self-employed; European aid becomes public shares with decision rights. Claimed jobs and unemployment outcomes are forecasts.

Read the full urgent-plan tax and essentials-price proposals. Extra-profit levy supports small-business/cooperative/self-employed credit payments. 1000 essential products return to December 2021 prices; energy price setting is changed.

Read the complete energy, housing and social-services lists. Energy benefit equals 40% of electrical and professional fuel costs via tax benefits. Mortgage help is funded by bank levies. Social aid aims at household income of 1080 euros; this is distinct from individual pensions/wages.
Read the full social-spending chapter introduction and European-average funding objective. The chapter number differs from the index; forecasts are not independently certified.

Read every healthcare bullet: universal public free care, primary-care restructuring, 1000 million more each legislature year, wait-list/precarity/end-referral objectives and national pharmaceutical industry. Original spelling errors remain exact in quotations.

Read every education bullet: no temporary school buildings next course, complete staffing, classroom ratio at most 20, vocational expansion, indefinite experienced associated faculty, university fees reduced 50% and scholarships doubled. No universal immediate zero tuition.

Read all five cultural axes: restored funding/jobs, industry, heritage/nature, broad participation and access as a right. No specific universal free museum entry. Printed chapter number differs from index.
Read the needs/rights section divider in full. No policy text or endnote.

Read all housing measures: supports 3% annual rent-rise cap but proposes rent below 25% of each area's average salary; limits on bank/fund housing ownership; public stock 15%, half social rent; mortgage-rise freeze at pre-August-2022 level while central-bank rates stay at least 1%; recovery of sold subsidised housing. These are distinct measures.

Read the eviction continuation and pull quote. Evictions paused while crisis lasts, with mortgage principal/interest moratorium for family homes. No permanent unlimited moratorium or automatic debt forgiveness.

Read all wage-equality and gender-violence text. A 1200-euro wage or pension minimum for women conflicts with the general 1080 pension detail and 1000 overview. Repetition and retrospective statistics are source content, not independent facts.

Read the entire violence section continuation and both proposals: budget rises from claimed 500 to 1000 million within a legislature, victim protection/economic support/specialist training, plus sexuality/equality education throughout schooling. Statistics remain attributed.

Read every environmental diagnosis and carbon-tax proposal: progressive levy for large firms emitting more than 50000 tonnes CO2 yearly, environmental earmarking and higher pollution fines. Corporate threshold matters; no general household carbon tax follows.

Read every continuation measure: fully municipal photovoltaic communities, doubled fire prevention/extinction resources and public year-round forest firefighters, nuclear closure in two years with worker relocation, renewable development outside major utilities' control.

Read the complete democratic reform page, including elector assemblies and possible recall for flagrant noncompliance, Citizen Security Law repeal, electoral/party-financing/participation laws and debates on LGBT rights. No specific electoral formula or exact LGBT provision is stated.

Read both democratic continuation bullets: remove migrant-worker rights restrictions through immigration-law reform; oppose international institutions overriding democratically expressed decisions to impose cuts. Not blanket EU/NATO exit or unconditional entry.

Read all social and territorial unity proposals: broad front, voluntary unity respecting nationalities/regions, and knowledge of Spain's different languages in all national study plans. No mandatory fluency or abolition of every regional power is specified.

Read every foreign-policy bullet: Russian troops out of Ukraine, sovereignty/territorial integrity, support including arms/humanitarian/refugee aid, autonomous policy from US/NATO, oppose Rota antimissile expansion and US-directed spending rises, enforce stated 1986 NATO conditions including military-structure nonintegration/base dismantling. No unconditional NATO exit proposition.

Read and visually inspected the full final campaign page, party logo, Congress/Senate 23J instruction, manifesto, website, QR and social handles. No further page, annex or footnote in this recovered variant.

uncertainties: All numeric positions remain null until corpus cross-reference, directly authored rubrics and reopened independent calibration.
Recovered PROG.-23J_05.pdf has 48 pages; indexed PROG.-23J.pdf is described as 53 pages. Completeness of the wider programme family/possible annex is unresolved.
Native extraction corrected a non-zero-indexed cross-reference table; text extraction completed. Repeated graphical headers are missing from native text and were visually checked.
Minimum figures conflict: overview 1000 euros for wages/pensions; detailed salary 1200, pension 1080; women-specific salary/pension 1200. Preserve conflicts and do not pick a convenient amount.

Page 19 printed required pension resources 259000 conflicts with its 53700 mobilised/+38000 balance, total required 196100 and page 29 pension estimate 15700. Visual inspection confirms the printed inconsistency.

Tasa Cero means a bank levy and mortgage help, not zero interest. Phased salary caps retain distinct public/contractor amounts. Whole-law repeal and broad rights principles do not establish every individual provision.
Economic/statistical/causal claims and revenue/job forecasts remain source attributions, not public neutral explanatory facts or validated effects.
authorship: Direct complete source reading and authored English analysis, preserving exact native Spanish excerpts; deterministic hash/literal/page validation only, no question or position generator.
